title: Finance + Reconciliation Control
approvedBy: User autonomous finance/reconciliation master command authorization
requirements: Reuse existing FinanceLine, Accounting invoice/payment events, Booking, Task, Approval and Audit data; do not create a second finance engine.
Add booking/job reconciliation control for revenue, cost, margin, AR, AP, payments, disputed balances and finance closeout readiness.
Classify reconciliation state using compatible derived states OPEN, MATCHED, PARTIAL, DISPUTED, BLOCKED and CLOSED without database enum changes.
Detect unresolved invoice balances, disputes, missing revenue/cost, unfinalized finance lines and payment anomalies already represented by existing accounting events.
Expose finance reconciliation dashboard with row-level exception reasons, filters, direct remediation links and downloadable CSV report.
Require reconciliation-clean pre-close validation before financial closeout.
Preserve payment idempotency, duplicate-reference protection, maker-checker/four-eyes, role/data scope, privacy and audit controls.
Test job to invoice to payment/payable to reconciliation to closeout plus partial, duplicate, overpayment, dispute, missing-cost, margin-variance and reopen/correction scenarios.
invariants: No database migration or new table.
No breaking API contract or business-model change.
Preserve frozen CR-010, CR-011 and CR-012 accepted behavior.
Free-tier only; no Redis unless verified mandatory.
No production runtime/DNS changes; PRODUCTION_TRAFFIC OFF, LIVE_PROVIDERS OFF, REAL_MONEY OFF.
note: Autonomous staging-only finance/reconciliation development. Safe in-scope fixes may be applied and retested without intermediate approval.
